title: Enabling or Disabling a Scan Rule

blocks.text: After you configure the scan rule for a resource, you must enable the scan rule to initiate the according to the configured schedule, or disable it to pause scanning without deleting the rule.
To enable or disable a scan rule:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Scan Settings.
For the scan rule you want to change the status, click the Scan Enable/Disable toggle in that rule’s row.
Enabled: The scan rule is active and runs according to its configured schedule.
Disabled: The scan rule is inactive and does not run according to its configured schedule.
Read the confirmation message that appears, then click Enable or Disable to apply the changes.

blocks.text: The scan rule is enabled or disabled per its status.

blocks.item: When you disable a scan rule, any full scans that are currently in progress are completed, but subsequent incremental scans are disabled.
To stop the full scan immediately, you need to first stop the scan from the Actions menu on the Scan Settings page.
